title: Refine interactive tokens and responsive constraint templates for chart/button families
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce layout drift and publishing friction for the button and chart component families by introducing a small set of interactive tokens (hover/focus/pressed) and a canonical responsive-constraint template that preserves visual intent across breakpoints and nested auto-layout contexts.

Scope:
- Audit current button and chart variants to extract tokenized color/spacing/typography for interactive states.
- Create a responsive-constraint template that standardizes 'min/max' behavior and spacing anchors for nested auto-layouts (cards, tables, panels).
- Update representative instances in top 10 product screens to validate behavior.
- Add publish gating checks (variant naming pattern, token mapping coverage, no raw pixel-painted text layers).

Out of scope: cross-platform token sync, icon library migrations, or a full rename sweep of unrelated components.

Acceptance criteria:
- New tokens exist in the Figma library and are referenced by all updated button and chart variants.
- Responsive-constraint template applied to sampled instances shows consistent shrink/grow behavior at 320/768/1440 widths.
- Designers can publish the library without manual fixes for at least 90% of updated components.
- QA checklist and a 1-page runbook for engineers on variant-to-prop mapping are delivered.

Success metrics:
- <30% PRs to the library that include manual auto-layout corrections after publishing.
- Fewer visual regressions reported in the next two sprints compared to the prior baseline.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: large component families will require manual instance fixes. Mitigation: prioritize the most-used instances and provide a batch-swap script for common layer renames.
- Risk: token collision with existing semantic tokens. Mitigation: publish the new tokens in a separate scope and run a token compatibility pass with Design Ops.
comments: 2025-11-05 - Kickoff: Reviewed library usage analytics with Product — buttons (global) and charts (insights) are top-of-list. Agreed to focus first on primary/secondary button families and line/area chart cards.
2025-11-10 - Audit complete: Exported CSV of 312 instances referencing legacy spacing values. Flagged ~48 instances with manually overridden constraints (stacked auto-layout inside grid).

2025-11-14 - Design review: Proposed token names (btn.interactive.hover/bg, btn.interactive.focus/outline, chart.padding.responsive) — Liam N. and Maya S. requested shorter prefixes. Decided on 'ui-btn-hover' and 'ui-chart-pad' for now to avoid ambiguous 'interactive' namespace.

2025-11-20 - Prototype: Implemented responsive-constraint template in Figma and tested in three representative pages. Observed undesired label truncation in compact mode; adjusted min-width anchor to use content sizing with a 12px padding floor.
2025-11-27 - Engineering sync: Carmen R. asked for a mapping doc for variant -> props to support runtime flagging. Created 'variant-to-prop-mapping.md' in the design repo and linked as artifact.
2025-12-01 - Pre-publish QA: Automated token coverage script reports 92% coverage for updated components. Remaining 8% are legacy instances that will be handled with targeted batch swaps next week.
2025-12-02 - Blocker discovered: One chart atom uses a rasterized axis layer preventing tokenization. Created follow-up DES-81256 to request vector rebuild; marked as dependency.
notes_for_release: Include short migration notes in the release announcement: how to opt-in to new tokens, where to find helper batch-swap scripts, and a list of known legacy instances that require manual attention.
